description: Source code for VideoDmpWriter class handling video dump logging for starboard player, including registration of players, dumping configs and access units, and writing to files.

classes.name: PlayerToWriterMap
classes.description: Manages mapping between SbPlayer instances and their corresponding VideoDmpWriter objects, with thread safety.

classes.name: VideoDmpWriter
classes.description: Handles writing video dump data to files, including dumping configs and access units.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::VideoDmpWriter
methods.description: Constructor that creates a dump file and writes initial headers.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::~VideoDmpWriter
methods.description: Destructor that closes the dump file.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerCreate
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a player is created; registers the player and dumps configs.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerWriteSample
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a sample is written; dumps the access unit.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::OnPlayerDestroy
methods.description: Static callback invoked when a player is destroyed; unregisters the player.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::DumpConfigs
methods.description: Dumps audio and video configuration data to the dump file.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::DumpAccessUnit
methods.description: Dumps a media sample (audio/video) to the dump file.

methods.name: VideoDmpWriter::WriteToFile
methods.description: Writes data to the dump file.
